sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Contra Vision North America manufactures and sells perforated window films for one-way vision graphics, privacy applications, and print substrates for advertising and branding.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Atlanta, GA · Size: <$50M · Products: One-Way Vision Window Films, Frosted Privacy Films, Perforated Window Films, Print Substrates, ScorchProtect Film, Privacy Films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Contra Vision North America scores 28 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (24/25). Nothing was found for industry fit, event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (53% similar on films, window, graphics, advertising); Mactac (39% similar on films, print, film, signage); Drytac (39% similar on films, print, window, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
